_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the @thearchv.ai Instagram carousel. Nothing here is repeated anywhere else: build.mjs generates every CSS rule below from this file, so a value changed here is changed everywhere. Same discipline as match-covers/carousel/tokens.json. Adopted by founder ruling 2026-08-04, which killed the washed-slate panel format (#1A3645 box on #162C38) that shipped on 2026-08-03.
_migration: PALETTE MIGRATED 2026-08-14, then UNHARDCODED 2026-09-08 (founder, in session, closing the judgment call this key had left open for 29 renders). The colour block is no longer literal: build.mjs resolves a pair from brand-colors.json at build time, per the palette block below. Pair id comes from --pair N, else deck.pair, else least-recently-used across the recent decks in content/, so the lane rotates instead of shipping pair 10 forever. The chosen id and its resolved hexes are written back into the deck JSON as resolved_palette so the ledger, the performance row and the next run can all read what actually rendered. chrome._comment prose below still says GOLD descriptively; that is historical commentary.

canvas._comment: 4:5, the Instagram carousel ceiling. Rendered at deviceScaleFactor 2 from a 1080x1350 CSS box.

type._comment: D-2026-08-14a, applied here 2026-09-08 (founder, in session). Archivo Black carries claims and headlines; Marcellus at weight 700 carries ALL numbers and context lines, which on this deck means the chip numeral, the say and fine copy, the source line and every chrome mark. Both faces are the OFL files in fifa.archv/brand/fonts/, loaded by absolute file URL from @font-face so a build written anywhere still resolves them, and render.mjs waits on document.fonts.ready. The previous Anton over Archivo pairing came off Google Fonts and was never the ratified system; it survived 29 renders as a reported code gap.

scale._comment: Headline sizes in CSS px at 1080 wide. xl/lg/md picked per slide in the content JSON; the headline must fill most of the frame. RECALIBRATED 2026-09-08 when the display face moved from Anton to Archivo Black (D-2026-08-14a). Anton is condensed and Archivo Black is not, so the old sizes overflowed every slide of the first deck built on them, slide 1 by 451px. A binary search on this deck put the largest fitting scale factor at 0.817 of the Anton sizes; these values sit at about 0.78 instead, deliberately short of that edge so an ordinary deck is not already at the overflow boundary on build 1. Body sizes are at about 0.87, Marcellus 700 running wider than Archivo at the same px. The overflow guard in render.mjs is unchanged and still refuses the render rather than truncating.

sources._comment: Founder 2026-09-09, explainer set: when a deck sets sources_on_last_slide, every citation is collected into one dimmed small-text block pinned above the foot row on the final slide, and slides 1 to 3 carry no src line. The per-slide SourceMissing guard is satisfied by the deck-level block on those decks only; the daily desk lane is unchanged.

chrome._comment: Every slide carries the same four marks so four images read as one object. kicker_default is the weekly build-log lane; the daily news lane may substitute its own word (founder 2026-08-04) and everything else in the system still holds.
chrome._swipe_comment: Founder instruction 2026-08-05: 'for all carousels, add an arrow at the bottom right telling people to swipe.' This deck already carried the word; what changed that night is that it is now GOLD (accent) rather than cream, matching the cue shipped in match-covers/carousel/build_chrome.py, and that the LAST SLIDE CARRIES NOTHING in that position. The old swipe_final of 'FOLLOW ->' was an arrow on the one slide with nowhere to swipe to, and slide 4 already ends on the gold FOLLOW @THEARCHV.AI block, so the arrow was pointing at a CTA that was directly above it. The key is deliberately gone rather than emptied: build.mjs draws the cue on non-final slides only and does not read a final-slide value, so a key here would be dead weight that a later edit could wrongly rewire.
chrome.chip: big numeral over OF NN, gold-outlined rounded box, top right

hard_rules.slide_count: FOUR slides per story. Canon D-2026-08-04l. Hook, evidence with named sources, the turn for someone building, CTA.
hard_rules.type_led: The headline fills most of the frame and is the design. No panel box holding a small centred sentence in an otherwise empty card.
hard_rules.source_on_slide: Every number carries its named source on the slide it appears on. No number ships without one. This does not relax for a restyle.
hard_rules.language: British English, full entity names, no em dashes. First person is permitted on this account.
hard_rules.overflow: GUARDED. render.mjs measures every slide and refuses to write PNGs when content exceeds the frame. An overflow is a rewrite, never a truncation.
hard_rules.read_back: Every rendered slide is opened as an image and looked at before it is queued. A build log saying DONE is not evidence.

palette._comment: brand-colors.json is the render-time authority (D-2026-08-14a). eligible lists the ids this lane may draw: 9 and 10 are MAIN, 4 to 7 rotate behind them. 2, 3 and 8 are RETIRED and 1 is identity-only (wordmark, watermark, CTA plates), so neither set appears here. bg is the pair's dark, fg its light, accent its registered third.

derived._comment: panel is a RAISED SURFACE ONLY, never a container the headline sits in. dim is the fine line. Pair 10's two values are the founder-seen ones this deck shipped on from 14 August and are kept literal so nothing about the existing look moves. Any other pair falls back to the blend in build.mjs: panel = dark 8 per cent toward light, dim = light 30 per cent toward dark.
